title: Subscription.WaitReady requires a context with a deadline
answers: how to call WaitReady on a nats Subscription
body: Subscription.WaitReady(ctx) is documented to require a context that carries a deadline (pkg/infra/nats/subscriber.go, pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go). Callers such as natsNotifier.trySubscribe wrap the incoming ctx with context.WithTimeout(ctx, defaultMaxBackoff) before calling WaitReady rather than passing an undeadlined context straight through.
applies: any caller of Subscription.WaitReady in pkg/infra/nats or pkg/storage/unified/resource
